annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a network-marketing earning opportunity with a claim that viewers can earn "three thousand to five thousand daily" and presents the Forsage platform as a real way to earn dollars. The video shows Forsage programs with partner and team counts, paid BUSD tiers, and upgrade options, linking participation and increasing program levels to the promoted earning opportunity. The title, call for likes and subscriptions, and claim of providing live proof encourage viewers to engage with the offer rather than critically examine it.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotion explicitly describes network marketing and the visible Forsage interface shows multi-person relationship indicators such as partners and team counts alongside x3/x4 program tiers and BUSD upgrade amounts. This connects earnings-related participation to a multi-person structure rather than showing only an ordinary one-level referral.
